theme.name: Voluntary sector-led implementation group
theme.claim: A voluntary sector-led implementation group chaired by Sir Martyn Lewis will put the proposals into practice.

text.line: Mr Wilson has also announced that Sir Martyn Lewis will chair a voluntary sector-led implementation group on these proposals, to put them into practice.

theme.name: Crown Representative priorities
theme.claim: Government is still identifying the key priorities for the Crown Representative so that the role complements the public services programme.

text.line: Government is currently identifying key priorities for the Crown Rep which will complement the public services programme.
